hero.glas_aria: The homepage of amakhosi.be on a computer, as a visitor sees it. The image slowly scrolls from top to bottom.
caps: The headline says it straight away: Koninklijk genieten, helemaal privé. One button: Reserveer uw moment.
The ribbon of amenities runs along. Below it, the welcome in warm African surroundings.
Serif headings, espresso and gold. The style of the business runs through every section.
The photo grid: whirlpool, Finnish sauna, walk-in shower, lounge and fireplace, bedroom suite.

cases.kort: New website for a private sauna and wellness in Hamont-Achel, with online booking and payment, automatic emails and a site Google reads well.
cases.gemaakt: Website · Online booking and payment · Automatic emails · Easy to find on Google
beats: A luxury private sauna and wellness in Hamont-Achel. Guests have the whole wellness to themselves.

A new website in espresso and gold, with serif headings, an opening image with the whirlpool in an arch, a running ribbon of amenities and a photo grid of the rooms. Online booking with immediate payment. Automatic emails with confirmation, reminder and follow-up. And built so Google reads the site well.
A guest picks a moment, pays straight away and gets confirmation, reminder and follow-up in their inbox automatically.

cases.kort: Website, online calendar and automatic emails for an aesthetic clinic in Hasselt. Over 263 days: 650 of 681 appointments confirmed, 0 no-shows.
cases.alt: Homepage of clinic3d.be: a light site with the headline Natuurlijke schoonheid, wetenschappelijk onderbouwd, a photo of the doctor at the desk and the button Boek je gratis consult.
beats: Aesthetic clinic in Hasselt, led by Dr. Kenis.
The website, the online calendar and the automatic emails. Patients pick a moment themselves. Confirmation and reminder go out automatically.
Measured over 263 days: 650 of the 681 appointments confirmed and not a single no-show.
cases.meet_noot: Measured over 263 days. The figures come from the system itself.

quote.text: 227 appointments in 104 days, not a single no-show, and my calendar is fuller than ever. My clients book themselves now. I don't have to do a thing.

cases.kort: New website for a non-profit in Heers, connected to automated follow-up and a central CRM.
cases.alt: Homepage of mett-u.be: a green header VZW Mett-U with two buttons and a photo of volunteers in the vegetable garden.
beats: A new website, connected to automated follow-up and a central CRM.
The site does not stand alone: the follow-up and the CRM are attached to it.

cases.kort: New website for an organic and care farm in Vechmaal, with their story and their produce.
cases.alt: Homepage of kleinhof.be: a grain field with the headline Biologisch kleinschalig and two blocks Bio-boerderij and Zorg-boerderij.
cases.soort: Organic and care farm · Vechmaal · Liesbeth and Gert
beats: A small-scale organic and care farm in Vechmaal, the same village as EM Launchpad.
A new website with their story, the organic farm and the care farm, and their produce.
Anyone looking for them sees straight away who they are and what they grow.

cases.kort: New website for baby wellness and care for mums in Lommel, with the booking system and add-ons, a digital gift card and automatic emails.
cases.alt: Homepage of bambine.be: a baby peeking out from under a white towel, with the headline Een warm bad voor de allerkleinsten and the buttons Reserveer jullie moment and Bekijk de cadeaubonnen.
cases.soort: Baby wellness and care for mums · Lommel · Ine
cases.gemaakt: Website · Booking system with add-ons · Digital gift card · Automatic emails
beats: Baby wellness, care for mums and pampering moments in the Vivaldi gallery in Lommel. Ine works one on one.
A new website in gold, light brown and white, with arched images and the prices laid out like a menu. Plus the booking system with add-ons, a digital gift card and automatic emails.
Parents book a moment online themselves and can add an extra, such as a gentle wash. A gift card can be bought straight away in digital form.
